evaluation_title: Geometric Evidence & SIFT/RANSAC Architectural Reliability Audit
objective: Audit false geometric correspondence risks across structural and textural twins

pair_sample_summary.evaluation_rule: Do not interpret zero observed false matches as zero real-world risk.

hazard_categories.exemplar_pair: Brihadeeswarar Temple (Thanjavur) vs Konark Sun Temple
hazard_categories.structural_mechanism: Tiered horizontal stone plinths, kirtimukha faces, and repetitive floral moldings with identical spatial frequencies
hazard_categories.risk_assessment: HIGH RISK at inlier threshold < 10. Accidental affine correspondences cluster in local 80x80px carving patches.

hazard_categories.structural_mechanism: Indo-Islamic and Indo-Saracenic voussoir arch curvature, flanking columns, and dentil cornices
hazard_categories.risk_assessment: MEDIUM RISK. Isolated arch close-ups lack minarets or ocean context, producing voussoir matches.

hazard_categories.exemplar_pair: Hampi Stone Chariot vs Konark Sun Temple (Chariot Wheels)
hazard_categories.structural_mechanism: Monolithic radial spokes, circular rims, central axle hubs, and surrounding friezes
hazard_categories.risk_assessment: HIGH RISK at inlier threshold < 10. Radial symmetry allows circular keypoints to pass homography under moderate deformation.

hazard_categories.exemplar_pair: Hawa Mahal (Jaipur) vs Taj Mahal Cenotaph Screens
hazard_categories.structural_mechanism: Periodic hexagonal and floral pierced marble/sandstone latticework
hazard_categories.risk_assessment: MEDIUM RISK. Periodic lattices generate ambiguous SIFT descriptors, occasionally matching repetitive grids.

hazard_categories.exemplar_pair: Konark Sun Temple Sandstone vs Qutub Minar Red Sandstone
hazard_categories.structural_mechanism: Granular weathered sandstone surfaces, lichen stains, and erosion channels
hazard_categories.risk_assessment: LOW RISK. Random texture does not form coherent affine homographies.

hazard_categories.structural_mechanism: White Makrana marble, grand central domes, corner kiosks, and arched entrance portals
hazard_categories.risk_assessment: LOW RISK for SIFT due to feature sparsity on smooth marble domes; HIGH RISK for Global CLIP semantic space.
